execution: Sequential native runs; no overlapping build/load tests, no downloads, synthetic data only; keep failed runs.

cache.method: Five frozen follow-ups, alternate retained/rebuilt order, temperature zero for protocol/correctness comparison. Identical requests apart from session identity; measurement precedes generation. Validate changed history/tools/instructions, ended session, app tool follow-up and fresh raw/native equivalence before promotion.
cache.promotion: All paired exact answers correct; reused tokens in each retained follow-up; median first text improves at least 20%; lifecycle controls pass. App tasks must have no unexplained regression.
cache.stop: At most one root-cause correction and one confirmation if integration fails. No prompt tuning.

firstMessage.method: Instrument content-free preparation stages, include acknowledged IPC first text. Cold means a new helper process, not an empty OS file cache. Tokenizer overlaps native weight loading; do not subtract nested timing as pure weight cost.
firstMessage.promotion: Only remove demonstrated redundant work or safely prepare under non-preemptive admission; preserve teardown, foreground priority and memory-pressure behavior.

memory.method: Synthetic relevant older facts plus newer partial-match distractors, other owners, corrections, restarts, no-result queries, delete/undo. Compare frozen recency SQL with relevance ranking; measure top-four evidence recall and query latency separately from model task scores.
memory.writeContract: Creation must not overwrite an existing topic. Replacement requires current identity/revision; preserve source, reject stale/cross-owner/deleted references, keep undo correct. Same-value create must not replace provenance.
memory.nativeValidation: Bounded saved-fact recall, general/private mixed question and correction replays on promising cache profiles; raw tool evidence and persisted state determine success, not lexical answer alone.

limits: No full leaderboard rerun; no new default memory preload; no runtime dependency changes; local results are not cross-hardware guarantees.

appValidation.note: Frozen full-rubric diagnostic comparison, not a leaderboard or statistical quality estimate. Same cases for both models and arms. Cache equivalence is separately deterministic.

firstTurnDiagnostics.reason: The Granite candidate omitted read tools on two baseline-passing cases; both were fresh turns with zero cached tokens. Add exact raw/native temperature-zero pairs to investigate API/prompt integration without rescoring stochastic tasks.
firstTurnDiagnostics.changes: No tuning of model instructions, sampling in the app, cases or rubrics.
